item.title: Principal UX Designer
item.description: The Principal UX Designer owns the university’s web design system and is accountable for the design work that shapes how audiences experience the university online, directing a small team of two freelance designers to deliver it.

item.title: Web Engineering Manager
item.description: The Web Engineering Manager is a hands-on technical leader within the Web Engineering and Ops team, part of the Communications and Marketing division at Vanderbilt. This position is responsible for architecting, building, and modernizing the university’s web applications and digital products, with a primary emphasis on front- and back-end engineering, systems integration, and AI-enabled ways of working.

item.title: Data Sharing Coordinator - PT Term
item.description: The ARPA-H Data Sharing Coordinator will support the coordination and implementation of data-sharing activities for the ARPA-H research program.
